headline: Mistral opens its 1-trillion-parameter Large 4 model
body: Mistral released the weights of Large 4, a 1-trillion-parameter model aimed at coding and cyber defence, and The Information reported DeepSeek and Moonshot built their latest models using OpenAI's Astra outputs; together they cut Power Concentration by 0.32. GitHub said agents opened over 40% of pull requests in September (AI Autonomy +0.10). Swing-state polls found voters want AI safeguards, House Democrats proposed opposing AI bailouts and Finnish police opened a criminal probe into Google's data-center site (Tech Backlash +0.20). Enslaved God fell; Reversion and Libertarian Utopia rose. Contained stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance rose to -9.96 from -10.09.
movers_note: Enslaved God -0.3, mostly from the Astra distillation report (-0.10) and fading earlier news (-0.07). Reversion +0.2, mostly from the swing-state polls (+0.10) and the anti-bailout resolution (+0.10), partly offset by Mistral's open Large 4 (-0.03). Libertarian Utopia +0.2, mostly from the Astra distillation report (+0.10) and Mistral's open Large 4 (+0.08).
